title: LLM-based Models for Detecting Emerging Topics in Service Feedback

bias_targets.methodology: Using multinomial logistic regression with bootstrapped confidence intervals to detect and compare emerging, persistent, or disappearing service feedback topics across different age groups (e.g., under 19, 19-60, 60 and older).
Using multinomial logistic regression with bootstrapped confidence intervals to detect and compare emerging, persistent, or disappearing service feedback topics across male and female users.

Using multinomial logistic regression with bootstrapped confidence intervals to detect and compare emerging, persistent, or disappearing service feedback topics based on the user's preferred language (English vs. French).
